subject: sessionctx: disable fair locking in next-gen (#60698)
summary: In nextgen builds (compile-time `nextgen` tag), `tidb_pessimistic_txn_fair_locking` is forced to default OFF for new installs and attempting to enable it is rejected via sysvar validation (returns `ErrNotSupportedYet`). As a defensive backstop, `tikvTxn.StartFairLocking()` returns `kv.ErrNotImplemented` in nextgen. Classic-kernel behavior remains unchanged.
